utility.question: How much is the Growth plan?

result.reply: The Growth plan is $59 per month, billed monthly. You can also choose annual billing and pay for 10 months for a year of service.

utility.question: how many shipments do i get on starter

result.reply: Starter includes 300 shipments per month. Any additional shipments cost $0.05 each and are billed on your next invoice.

utility.question: What happens if I go over my monthly shipments on the Growth plan?

result.reply: On the Growth plan, shipments above your 2,000 monthly allowance cost $0.03 each. Overage charges are billed on your next invoice.

utility.question: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?

result.reply: Yes. Annual billing gives you 2 months free—you pay for 10 months.

utility.question: Do my unused shipments carry over to next month?

result.reply: No. Unused shipments don’t roll over to the next month.

utility.question: Do I need a credit card for the free trial?

result.reply: No. You don’t need a credit card to start the 14-day Growth plan trial. Postage for labels you buy during the trial is charged to the payment method you add when you buy your first label.

utility.question: How long is the trial and how many labels can I make?

result.reply: The Growth plan trial lasts 14 days and includes up to 50 shipments. Postage for labels you buy during the trial is still charged when you buy your first label.

utility.question: Can you extend my trial by a week? I haven't had time to test it.

result.reply: Sorry, trials can’t be extended. Every new account gets a 14-day Growth trial, and each business can use it once. If you’d like to discuss your options, I can connect you with a human agent.

utility.question: I'm on a monthly plan. If I cancel halfway through the month do I get the rest refunded?

result.reply: No. Monthly plans don’t receive refunds or prorated credits for the unused days. You can cancel from Settings > Billing > Cancel plan, and your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.

utility.question: I paid for a year 3 weeks ago and want to cancel. Can I get money back?

result.reply: I can’t confirm whether your annual plan is eligible for a refund. I’ll connect you with a human agent to help with your cancellation and refund request.

utility.question: How long do I have to void a USPS label?

result.reply: You can void an unused USPS label within 28 days of purchase. Any approved postage refund is returned to your Tidewell balance, and USPS refunds can take up to 21 days to be approved.

utility.question: I voided a label, why isn't the money back on my card?

result.reply: Voided postage is returned to your Tidewell balance, not your card. If it was a USPS label, approval can take up to 21 days; USPS labels can be voided within 28 days of purchase, and UPS and FedEx labels within 90 days.

utility.question: Which carriers do you support?

result.reply: Tidewell supports USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL Express, and Canada Post. You can use Tidewell’s discounted rates, or connect your own UPS, FedEx, or DHL Express account to use your negotiated rates. Canada Post is available only for shipments that start in Canada.

utility.question: Can I ship with Amazon Shipping through Tidewell?

result.reply: No. Tidewell does not currently support Amazon Shipping.

utility.question: Can I use my own negotiated USPS rates?

result.reply: Tidewell doesn’t support connecting your own USPS account for negotiated rates. You can use Tidewell’s discounted USPS rates instead. Connecting your own carrier account is available for UPS, FedEx, and DHL Express.
